## Checks

- [ ] New functionality or a fix comes with a test, or the description says why not
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`make test`, `pnpm check` or `npm run generate`, as far as touched)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Contracts, docs and website match the change
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or unverified claims
